status: STUDIO POLICY - DOCUMENTED / HUMAN PROOF REQUIRED FOR ASSETS

entries.name: Straight cut
entries.mechanism: Immediate image replacement without blending
entries.creative_use: Default for all storytelling; pace and emotional punctuation

entries.name: Cut on action
entries.mechanism: Join an action across two angles at its most readable motion point
entries.failure_check: Direction and limb state must agree

entries.name: Eyeline match
entries.mechanism: Cut from gaze to spatially coherent object or person
entries.creative_use: Point of view and audience attention

entries.name: Shot/reverse-shot
entries.mechanism: Alternate viewpoints across established conversation axis

entries.name: Reaction cut
entries.mechanism: Leave action to reveal another person's specific response

entries.name: Cut-in
entries.mechanism: Move to a close detail contained in the parent action

entries.name: Cutaway
entries.mechanism: Temporary detail or parallel view conceals omitted time

entries.name: Invisible dark cut
entries.mechanism: Cut across full-frame darkness or silhouette

entries.name: Foreground occlusion cut
entries.mechanism: Use a passing body or object to conceal the edit

entries.name: Motion-blur hidden cut
entries.mechanism: Place edit during high blur at similar flow direction

entries.name: Composition hold / delayed cut
entries.mechanism: Hold a frame until the dramatic information changes
entries.failure_check: Holding without new information feels slack

entries.name: Cut after movement
entries.mechanism: Wait for action completion rather than cut on impact

entries.name: Insert-and-return
entries.mechanism: Cut to an insert then return on changed context
entries.creative_use: Story detail without a full scene change

entries.name: Reverse angle inversion
entries.mechanism: Deliberately swap axis after a clear spatial reset

entries.name: Graphic match
entries.mechanism: Align shapes or dominant composition between shots
entries.failure_check: Looks ornamental when meanings do not connect

entries.name: Subject match
entries.mechanism: Align subject types, poses, profiles or silhouettes

entries.name: Action match
entries.mechanism: Continue a specific movement through the cut
entries.creative_use: Carry momentum across time and space

entries.name: Direction match
entries.mechanism: Preserve consistent movement vectors across shots

entries.name: Speed match
entries.mechanism: Cut between objects sharing apparent screen velocity

entries.name: Scale match
entries.mechanism: Keep a focal object the same screen size across shots
entries.creative_use: Conceal change of location or object

entries.name: Color match
entries.mechanism: Connect similar chromatic focal regions
entries.failure_check: Color as sole reason often feels thin

entries.name: Luminance match
entries.mechanism: Connect highlight/shadow distribution

entries.name: Texture match
entries.mechanism: Align grain, weave, foam, fabric or surface patterns
entries.failure_check: VFX smoothness conflicts with physical texture

entries.name: Eye-position match
entries.mechanism: Maintain eye coordinates or eye-line direction

entries.name: Object-function match
entries.mechanism: Different objects perform the same physical task

entries.name: Cause-and-effect match
entries.mechanism: Cut from action to its distant consequence
entries.failure_check: Implies causal link not in script

entries.name: Conceptual / intellectual match
entries.mechanism: Juxtapose unlike images that share an idea

entries.name: Sound match
entries.mechanism: Join matching sound signatures over different sources

entries.name: Gesture / behavior rhyme
entries.mechanism: Match an actor's posture, hesitation or habitual gesture

entries.name: Negative-space match
entries.mechanism: Connect vacant areas of composition across two shots
entries.failure_check: Subject enters wrong side of frame

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Smash cut
entries.mechanism: Abrupt, high-contrast change in tone or intensity

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Jump cut
entries.mechanism: Remove intermediate action within near-matched framing

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Elliptical cut
entries.mechanism: Omit an expected narrative interval
entries.creative_use: Trust viewer inference and increase pace

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Time-jump match
entries.mechanism: Match composition across different days or years
entries.creative_use: Make a passage of time immediate

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Flash-forward cut
entries.mechanism: Briefly show a later known or hypothetical event

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Flashback bridge
entries.mechanism: Transition to a prior event with an earned perceptual link

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Crosscutting
entries.mechanism: Alternate actions in separate locations

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Parallel montage
entries.mechanism: Interleave separate events with thematic relation

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Associative montage
entries.mechanism: Link images by evolving idea rather than continuity

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Metric montage
entries.mechanism: Organize cut lengths by a measurable progression

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Rhythmic montage
entries.mechanism: Edit to movement patterns inside shots

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Tonal montage
entries.mechanism: Edit on emotional qualities across images

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Overtonal montage
entries.mechanism: Layer metric, rhythmic and tonal tensions

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Intellectual montage
entries.mechanism: Make a new argument by image collision

entries.family: C. Structural, temporal, and spatial edits
entries.name: Split chronology
entries.mechanism: Interlace stages of one event nonlinearly

entries.name: J-cut / audio pre-lap
entries.mechanism: Bring next shot or scene sound in before the image

entries.name: L-cut / audio post-lap
entries.mechanism: Let preceding shot's sound outlive its image

entries.name: Sound bridge
entries.mechanism: Carry a common ambience, effect or music bed over the cut

entries.name: Audio match cut
entries.mechanism: Align related sound events from distinct environments

entries.name: Acoustic morph
entries.mechanism: Gradually transform a sound's spectrum or envelope into another

entries.name: Reverb-tail bridge
entries.mechanism: Carry the decay of a voice or struck object into next image

entries.name: Hard silence cut
entries.mechanism: Remove ambience/music exactly at the image change

entries.name: Ambience swap
entries.mechanism: Change environmental bed ahead of or after picture
entries.creative_use: Signal a new location before reveal

entries.name: Dialogue bridge
entries.mechanism: Complete one conversation's line over a new setting
entries.failure_check: Implies direct dialog at wrong place

entries.name: Musical downbeat cut
entries.mechanism: Cut exactly on a strong musical attack

entries.name: Anticipation cut
entries.mechanism: Change picture before a predicted drum or lyric event

entries.name: Afterbeat cut
entries.mechanism: Delay picture past rhythmic emphasis

entries.name: Sonic perspective shift
entries.mechanism: Transition diegetic sound from internal to external viewpoint
entries.creative_use: Alter relationship to character or space

entries.name: Cross dissolve
entries.mechanism: Blend adjacent shots through opacity

entries.name: Film dissolve (linear light)
entries.mechanism: Blend exposure response in linear-light space

entries.name: Additive dissolve
entries.mechanism: Add bright regions across frames while mixing

entries.name: Non-additive dissolve
entries.mechanism: Blend without additive brightening bias

entries.name: Fade to black
entries.mechanism: Gradually diminish picture into black
entries.failure_check: Cliche if used at every scene

entries.name: Fade to white
entries.mechanism: Gradually increase to white

entries.name: Dip to color
entries.mechanism: Pass through a selected solid color

entries.name: Linear wipe
entries.mechanism: One image reveals another along moving boundary

entries.name: Diagonal wipe
entries.mechanism: Slanted boundary reveal across frames

entries.name: Iris in/out
entries.mechanism: Circle opens or closes visual field

entries.name: Clock / radial wipe
entries.mechanism: Pivot a radial wipe around image center

entries.name: Venetian-blind wipe
entries.mechanism: Repeated strips replace image

entries.name: Page turn / peel
entries.mechanism: Peel image as physical page

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Whip pan
entries.mechanism: End and begin adjacent shots with matched fast pan

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Whip tilt
entries.mechanism: Use fast upward/downward camera tilt

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Swish zoom
entries.mechanism: Fast focal zoom bridges shots

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Body/lens cover
entries.mechanism: Hand, hat, coat or moving person briefly covers lens

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Door-frame pass
entries.mechanism: Camera passes a doorway edge into another set

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Wall / pillar wipe
entries.mechanism: Architecture crosses the full lens area

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Floor-to-floor tilt
entries.mechanism: Tilt to uniform floor and reverse into another space

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Sky-to-sky tilt
entries.mechanism: Use featureless sky as neutral bridge

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Rack-focus blur bridge
entries.mechanism: Defocus outgoing image and sharpen the next

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Foreground pass-through
entries.mechanism: Let moving object pass extremely close to lens

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Prism/refraction pass
entries.mechanism: Sweep glass or prism across field to conceal next shot

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Mirror reveal
entries.mechanism: Track into a reflection then open on new setting

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Lens flare occlusion
entries.mechanism: Bright source veils frame at join

entries.family: F. In-camera and physically motivated transitions
entries.name: Practical shutter close/open
entries.mechanism: Use physical lid, iris, curtain or aperture-like closing action

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Light leak
entries.mechanism: Use real or designed leak to cross cut

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Film burn
entries.mechanism: Let exposure-colored edge grow across frame

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Flash frame
entries.mechanism: Brief controlled exposure event around edit

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Strobe bridge
entries.mechanism: Alternate lit frames to change space

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Match flicker
entries.mechanism: Cut between two sources on coherent flicker phase

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Practical flare match
entries.mechanism: Match flaring fixtures across scenes

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Chroma wipe
entries.mechanism: Color field or gradient becomes matte

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Luma wipe
entries.mechanism: Reveal clip through ordered brightness regions

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Exposure-rack transition
entries.mechanism: Overexpose and recover into another image

entries.family: G. Light, exposure and color transitions
entries.name: Color-field dip
entries.mechanism: Use exact environmental or design color to bridge

entries.name: Alpha matte reveal
entries.mechanism: Use animated shape/transparency to reveal next plate

entries.name: Rotoscope / actor wipe
entries.mechanism: Isolate actor crossing foreground as scene behind changes

entries.name: Depth-based wipe
entries.mechanism: Use depth estimates to reveal by distance

entries.name: Object replacement bridge
entries.mechanism: One object turns into a related asset across a hidden cut

entries.name: Surface / texture swap
entries.mechanism: Replace a surface as it crosses frame

entries.name: Perspective portal
entries.mechanism: Move camera through a mapped aperture

entries.name: Camera projection reframe
entries.mechanism: Project still onto 3D cards to animate apparent space

entries.name: 3D match-move bridge
entries.mechanism: Track camera across independent plate sets

entries.name: Split screen / panel shift
entries.mechanism: Show multiple angles or settings in one frame then let one dominate

entries.name: Motion-vector dissolve
entries.mechanism: Warp frame elements along estimated motion before blend

entries.name: Particle carrying wipe
entries.mechanism: Practical fog, dust or particles reveal next space

entries.name: Liquid/refraction warp
entries.mechanism: Use fluid lensing as a scene bridge

entries.name: Speed-ramp cut

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Freeze-frame bridge
entries.mechanism: Hold an image then resume somewhere else

entries.name: Frame-stutter cut

entries.name: Step-printing

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Echo-trail transition
entries.mechanism: Layer earlier positions over moving body

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Reverse-motion join
entries.mechanism: Match forward action to reversed counterpart

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Temporal echo overlap
entries.mechanism: Overlay offset moments from same shot

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Timelapse-to-realtime cut

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Hyperlapse travel bridge
entries.mechanism: Speed location traversal across cut

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Motion-retiming morph
entries.mechanism: Interpolate two movement patterns

entries.family: I. Time, speed and movement manipulation
entries.name: Loop point join

entries.name: Pepper's Ghost reflection

entries.name: Pixilation human motion

entries.name: ASCII / typography transition

entries.name: On-beat cut
entries.mechanism: Hit a beat subdivision

entries.name: Off-beat cut
entries.mechanism: Shift against expected pulse
entries.failure_check: Feels like bad timing if unsupported

entries.name: Bar-line scene change
entries.mechanism: Change scene on musical bar boundary

entries.name: Pre-chorus lift cut
entries.mechanism: Use changed visual grammar before chorus begins

entries.name: Break/drop vacuum cut
entries.mechanism: Go to empty visual or silence at drop

entries.name: Lyric semantic match
entries.mechanism: Match pictured action/concept to lyric meaning

entries.name: Instrumental gesture match
entries.mechanism: Align action with drum, guitar or vocal articulation

entries.name: Movement accent cut
entries.mechanism: Cut on a dancer's internal accent rather than kick drum

entries.name: Polyrhythmic cut pattern
entries.mechanism: Use alternating durations in a repeating rhythmic ratio

entries.name: Call-and-response image alternation
entries.mechanism: Alternate visual subjects as musical motifs answer

entries.name: Stutter-phrase montage
entries.mechanism: Loop selected gesture in rhythmic variations

entries.name: Visual ostinato
entries.mechanism: Repeat one framing/pattern against changing events

entries.name: Cross-verse world flip
entries.mechanism: Change set/color/lens grammar at verse boundary

entries.name: One-take section pivot
entries.mechanism: Pass without cut then reveal changed geography or look

entries.name: Kuleshov-style reaction juxtaposition
entries.mechanism: Alter context shot around identical neutral face

entries.name: False continuity cut
entries.mechanism: Preserve surface continuity while reality changes

entries.name: Ontological cut
entries.mechanism: Cut to a world where basic scene rules have changed
entries.failure_check: No character response to impossible change

entries.name: Missing-beat cut
entries.mechanism: Omit expected consequence/action

entries.name: Discontinuous viewpoint cut
entries.mechanism: Shift to an impossible perspective

entries.name: Semantic contradiction
entries.mechanism: Pair images that cannot both be true

entries.name: Hard texture collision
entries.mechanism: Jump between radically different material surfaces

entries.name: Subjective memory flare
entries.mechanism: Use out-of-focus, optical light, or overlay as perceptual state

entries.name: Single-frame interruption
entries.mechanism: Insert one visual frame as formal rupture
entries.creative_use: Subliminal-feel marker without claim of subliminal influence

entries.name: Negative-space dissolve
entries.mechanism: Let foreground subject vanish into unoccupied composition

entries.name: Anti-match cut
entries.mechanism: Deliberately contradict matched vector, shape or rhythm

entries.name: Held absence cut
entries.mechanism: Stay on empty consequence rather than transition to next action

entries.name: Endpoint-keyframe interpolation
entries.mechanism: Generate movement between approved start/end plate stills

entries.name: Video-to-video keyframe modify
entries.mechanism: Modify live-action movement using start/end steering
entries.failure_check: Facial geometry, hands and camera drift

entries.name: Multi-keyframe controlled scene bridge
entries.mechanism: Define several intermediate visual states for one passage

entries.name: Generated motion-bridge insert
entries.mechanism: Create ONLY a short connector where neither source can cover cut

entries.name: Character-reference preservation pass
entries.mechanism: Constrain a transformed shot to approved identity reference

entries.name: Outpaint-to-reframe bridge
entries.mechanism: Extend frame edges for changed crop across cut

entries.name: Generated depth parallax
entries.mechanism: Infer layers to move between two still images

entries.name: Neural morph / semantic dissolve
entries.mechanism: Synthesize in-between images with changing category
entries.failure_check: Identity theft of scene / face drift

entries.name: Neural optical-flow repair
entries.mechanism: Interpolate missing frames between close movement states

entries.name: AI model-to-model bridge
entries.mechanism: Combine renders from separate engines via a stable intermediary plate
entries.failure_check: Color, faces and asset provenance drift

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Graphic-anchor match chain
entries.mechanism: 3+ consecutive shots preserve one geometry, horizon, or silhouette as the repeated anchor
entries.creative_use: Design a visual motif that moves across places or eras
entries.failure_check: Local pairwise match succeeds but sequence lacks narrative development

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Action / gesture relay
entries.mechanism: One movement vector or gesture passes from shot to shot through different subjects
entries.creative_use: Compress dispersed actions into a meaningful common behavior
entries.failure_check: Velocity, screen direction, or intent resets unexpectedly

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Behavior / expression relay
entries.mechanism: A repeated posture, gaze, hand position, or reaction shifts among performers or moments
entries.creative_use: Link characters through behavior without asserting identical identity
entries.failure_check: Micro-expression or face identity drift; forced psychology

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Camera-vector relay
entries.mechanism: Maintain camera trajectory, axis of motion, and focal center across successive shots
entries.creative_use: Suggest a single observation moving through distinct spaces
entries.failure_check: Parallax, lens perspective and acceleration inconsistent

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Scale / perspective relay
entries.mechanism: Match position and size of a subject as actual objects change in scale or focal length
entries.creative_use: Travel from macro to environment while preserving eye trace
entries.failure_check: Lens distortion or optical size makes match obvious

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Practical subject transformation chain
entries.mechanism: A recognizable object silhouette or function is relayed through multiple practical subjects
entries.creative_use: Evolve a motif without inventing a literal metamorphosis
entries.failure_check: VFX look, prop continuity, or unrelated substitutions

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Era / time-skip graphic chain
entries.mechanism: Repeat framing and action across differentiated times, costumes, sets, or locations
entries.creative_use: Compress years or cycles into a legible time progression
entries.failure_check: Era change indistinguishable; wardrobe and chronology errors

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Rhythmic match run
entries.mechanism: Several matched cuts fall on chosen beats, syncopations, or repeated instrumental attacks
entries.creative_use: Give music a deliberate recurring visual grammar
entries.failure_check: Mechanical beat spam obscures phrasing and performance

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Phrase-length counterpoint relay
entries.mechanism: Match shots at musical phrase boundaries while deliberately varying shot durations within phrases
entries.creative_use: Support long musical structure without every cut landing on a kick
entries.failure_check: Missed hook/lyric emphasis or rhythm feels arbitrary

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Sound-motif multi-shot relay
entries.mechanism: A related transient, sustained tone, breathing pattern, or timbre bridges successive places
entries.creative_use: Unify a dispersed montage through the sound design
entries.failure_check: Audio implies an unwanted event or creates spatial confusion

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Conceptual escalation chain
entries.mechanism: Each cut retains a perceivable anchor while the metaphor changes or intensifies
entries.creative_use: Build an argument or emotional progression across shots
entries.failure_check: A pretty sequence has no escalating information

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Deliberate broken-match ending
entries.mechanism: Establish a predictable matching rule, then violate it once at the intended payoff
entries.creative_use: Represent fracture, refusal, reversal, or interruption
entries.failure_check: Failure reads accidental or upstages the moment

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Circular return / loop closure
entries.mechanism: Final shot matches opening shape, movement, or action for intentional recurrence
entries.creative_use: Music-video loops, motifs of cycles and repetition
entries.failure_check: Loop disguises a missing dramatic conclusion

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Matched occlusion relay
entries.mechanism: Door frames, lens covers, bodies or architectural occluders carry a series between locations
entries.creative_use: Connect separate filmed environments with practical concealment
entries.failure_check: Unmotivated portals, bad matte edges, lighting mismatch

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Parallel-chain interweave
entries.mechanism: Two distinct match sequences alternate without losing their own visual rules
entries.creative_use: Compare two journeys, characters, or rhythms while preserving separate identities

entries.family: O. Multi-shot match sequences (OVS composite grammar)
entries.name: Neural intermediate chain sandbox
entries.mechanism: Use AI only for limited, approved interstitial images between fixed genuine plates
entries.creative_use: R&D where practical match, blocking and compositing cannot deliver
entries.failure_check: Face, hands, accessories, lens, gravity, provenance or location drift

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Layered cutout collage bridge
entries.mechanism: Rotoscoped subjects, designed shapes, and independent footage layers overlap then replace the base scene.
entries.creative_use: Editorial portraiture, chorus visualization, parallel memory or image-media contrast.
entries.failure_check: Separate masks, intentional matte edges, cohesive shadow/perspective/texture; verify provenance and releases.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Still-photo flipbook handoff
entries.mechanism: A rapid, controlled progression of still frames develops movement before a selected still becomes live action.
entries.creative_use: Show time, growth or a performance change without synthetic motion.
entries.failure_check: Anchor frame registered; preserve temporal readability; inspect rapid luminance changes.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Practical tear / paper reveal
entries.mechanism: A photographed or hand-animated paper edge exposes the incoming scene as an actual layer.
entries.creative_use: Tactile analog section changes and documentary/editorial motifs.
entries.failure_check: Paper grain, shadow direction, matte continuity, image rights and no stock-looking wipe.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Split-screen panel birth
entries.mechanism: A single coherent frame grows into two or more distinct views by motivated edge, subject or action division.
entries.creative_use: Compare concurrent locations or reveal unseen reactions.
entries.failure_check: Panel count and crop readable on mobile; no false continuity or disallowed comparison.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Multi-panel collapse to hero frame
entries.mechanism: Multiple panels contract or join into one authored hero shot, synchronized to a meaningful image or music cue.
entries.creative_use: Resolve competing perspectives and re-focus the audience.
entries.failure_check: Match hero frame native aspect/scale; panel boundaries never obscure key performance.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Diegetic display / nested-screen relay
entries.mechanism: An in-world display, window, printed image or projection becomes a frame inside the edit and can occupy the final canvas.
entries.creative_use: Move between mediated viewpoint and direct lived scene.
entries.failure_check: Screen content source and clearance; parallax, resolution, reflection and viewing-angle logic.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Multi-frame call-and-response montage
entries.mechanism: Two or more independent panels alternate attention through timing, action alignment or complementary sound.
entries.creative_use: Music-video ensembles, separated performance, simultaneous choices.
entries.failure_check: Do not let split panels reduce facial readability or defeat musical phrasing.

entries.family: P. Collage, mixed media and multi-frame composition (OVS implementation family)
entries.name: Collage-to-live-action deconstruction
entries.mechanism: A layered collage sequentially strips or resolves into an uninterrupted source plate.
entries.creative_use: Introduce a stylized interior perception then return to grounded physical reality.
entries.failure_check: Final plate must exist; identity and lighting remain authorized; synthetic merges prohibited without approval.

naming_note: O family contains OVS studio-defined composite workflow names, not standard industry labels.
